provenance.ruling: Adam 2026-08-10 (ruling 9): build the seam-gap metric for GGE1.
provenance.definition: seam_gap = frac(consolidation seam, G6.4 sustained-RSA>=0.97) - frac(readability onset, G6.2 median-own-rank<10k). Convention note: onset=L0 for cells readable from layer 0 (never-gating); the gap is then the consolidation depth itself.
provenance.status: UNREGISTERED exploratory; Phase-5 check owed before paper contact.

reading: Gap collapses with scale: ~0.27 at 2B, ~0.21-0.24 at 9B, 0.000/0.022 at 27B — the single number carrying G6.4's 'two measures, same seam is scale-emergent' claim.
